pb-open-posting.title: Open networks
pb-open-posting.scope: Connect your own account. This checks access only. Each exact post still needs your approval and the client approval where required. Credentials last for this session.
pb-open-posting.connected: Account verified for this session. No post was sent.
pb-open-posting.disconnected: Disconnected. Existing uncertain posts still need inspection.
pb-open-posting.failed: The account could not be verified. Check its permissions and try connecting again.
pb-open-posting.stale: The account changed. Reload this section and review its current settings.
pb-open-posting.help.bluesky: Create an app password in your own Bluesky account. Use your exact handle and public server.
pb-open-posting.help.mastodon: Use your exact instance and account with a token allowed to write statuses. Posts are public. Chausar supports up to five hundred characters, or the lower limit set by your instance.
pb-open-posting.help.telegram: Add your bot as a channel administrator and allow it to post. This connection sends no direct messages.
pb-open-posting.help.discord: Create an incoming webhook in the chosen server channel. Chausar disables mentions and waits for the message response.
